line.en: friday open-air market on the promenade by club studio, 40 local vendors, free entry, 5 to 9 pm. easy to combine with dinner downtown.
line.de: freitags offener markt auf der promenade bei club studio, 40 lokale händler, eintritt frei, 17 bis 21 uhr. gut mit einem abendessen in downtown zu verbinden.
line.tr: club studio yanındaki promenadda cuma açık hava pazarı, 40 yerel satıcı, giriş ücretsiz, 17:00-21:00. downtown'da akşam yemeğiyle birleştirmek kolay.

sparks.why: Miami Worldcenter Night Market, Fridays 5-9 pm, per miamiworldcenter.com; listed for Fri 13 Nov in The Miami Guide's November calendar.
